integrity: The infinite-degree tail is proved analytically; the finite exceptional spectrum is reproduced by standalone exact-rational Python. This is not independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact-degree, unweighted, centered regular-dodecahedral vertex evaluation only; no simultaneous-band or noise-optimal reconstruction claim. Classical group-harmonic sources remain a bounded historical novelty risk.
title: Exact harmonic-sampling spectra and the last interpolation gap of the regular dodecahedron
